caption: The drawing shows two main objects positioned horizontally on a plain background: a naval cutlass at the top and a leather scabbard below it. The cutlass has a metallic, slightly curved blade that tapers to a point, with rust or patina suggesting wear. The hilt features a gold or brass color with a rounded pommel, a grip with a series of raised bands, and a curved knuckle guard. The leather scabbard below is dark brown or black, reinforced with a series of evenly spaced brass or copper studs along its length, and it tapers to a metal tip. Handwritten text beneath the objects reads: "NAVAL CUTLASS AND LEATHER SCABBARD. U.S.N. 1845 FROM 'THE HARTFORD' FARRAGUT'S FLAGSHIP."
title: Cutlass and Leather Scabbard
